target_customer: Background check companies (screeners), banks and lenders that must verify employment history
problem: Employment verification still depends on phone calls, emails and faxes to employer HR departments, done by internal teams or outsourced call centers.
business_model: B2B SaaS/services priced per verification (pricing not found)
product_category: AI voice and email agents for employment verification (HR tech)

founders.name: Peter Marler
previous_startups: Robin Golf (venture-backed golf equipment company; outcome not found)
founders.background_notes: Background from third-party profile pages, not verified against a primary source.

technical_complexity.rationale: Voice agents that call employers, navigate phone trees and log audit trails were feasible with 2024 LLM and speech APIs, but compliance logging and reliability on real calls are the hard parts.

defensibility.rationale: Workflow integration with screeners and compliance logs may create some lock-in, but the underlying voice-agent stack was widely available in 2024.

takeover_risk_then.outcome: No source shows incumbents copying the voice-agent approach by 2026; Superunit remains active.

market_need_then: Background check firms spend labor on manual employer verification calls; YC page cites a 65% results-obtained rate and 1 business day turnaround (company-reported).

brand_strength.rationale: No press on the brand itself found; name carries no verification meaning and was used for an earlier accounting product too.

pivots.from: AI accounting agents for companies selling physical products (YC launch LW4)
pivots.to: AI agents for employment verification for background check companies
pivots.why: Not stated by a source; inferred from two differing YC launch listings and one co-founder remark.

outcome_analysis: Superunit is an early-stage S24 company that appears to have pivoted from accounting agents to employment-verification voice agents and is still active with a team of about five. No verified funding round, revenue or named customers are public, so outcome and trajectory are unknown beyond company claims of processing thousands of verifications a month.
notes: Funding unverified and conflicting: VCBacked lists Seed with a last round Oct 2024 (no amount); EveryDev lists $500,000 total; Extruct says pre-seed. None recorded as rounds. Competition search returned only undated aggregator pages (Truework, Truv, Checkr, The Work Number); not recorded as dated competitors. Location differs: YC says Los Angeles in data, one YC page San Francisco. Team size 2 vs 5 differs by source. Completeness pass: one seed round dated 2024-10 with no disclosed amount is recorded from VCBacked alone; it rests on a single database. Employbl calls the last raise pre-seed; the 500K total from EveryDev is not recorded.
